### Problem Statement
Is your feature request related to a problem or limitation? Please describe.
> (e.g., *I'm always frustrated when trying to export 100k+ rows with custom delimiters...*)

### Proposed Solution

### Alternative Solutions

### UI / Mockups / Examples
If applicable, provide UI sketches, mockups, or conceptual screenshots.

### Additional Context
Add any other context, performance requirements, or use cases here.
